prospective_admission: Configuration saves and installation create no readiness.
Explicit native configuration authority, current immutable revision and current source/destination permissions are mandatory.
DB-generated timestamp, actor, source timezone and global sequence/MAX call/leg cutoffs exclude old/in-flight IDs.
A late imported start timestamp cannot arm old calls; both observed IDs and immutable original start must be prospective.
Exactly unchanged rules can retain preceding readiness across unrelated catalogue saves; changed/unarmed rules cannot.
Permanent disable history is applied before readiness selection; reactivation does not release pending originals.

finite_ci_timeout.reason: Preserve every existing gate while adding populated M17 upgrade and 49 native cases.

upgrade_proof_scope: Actual M17 native origin/completion, actor, version and configuration records; compare all their original fields and columns, no raw snapshots exported.
upgrade_harness: Prepare committed M17 data in a guarded Rails runner, migrate normally, then boot the real application in one dedicated RSpec example with native check_all_pending! and exact schema receipt checks. Standard Rails suites keep rails_helper and schema maintenance unchanged. Existing .rspec keeps WebMock protections.
fixture_only_dependency_change: Detach only the new incoming FK within the already rollbackable older migration specs; validate deferred events first. Runtime FK remains enabled.
remaining: Atomic per-destination success receipts and attempts
Explicit activation UI/API and manual per-rule confirmation
CRM/Service Desk adapters and independent partial failures
Configuration by limited company/unit coverage; current global ACW writer stays protected
Representative scale and full account retirement with readiness history before production acceptance
sequence_compatibility_not_homologated: Prospective cutoffs are conservative for customized cached ID allocation. Validate native production sequence settings before any live executor activation; no sequence or database setting is changed here.
assignee_ui_code_audit: The existing select already uses projects.task.assign and authorized native project members. Do not duplicate it. Authorized selection still needs its own Chrome proof.
